title: Finance reports missing reconciliation file
body: Finance opened INC-1101 at 09:00:00Z on 2026-01-23 reporting that the nightly reconciliation output for 2026-01-15 is absent from the shared location. Files for every other date in January are present.

title: job reported success
body: Responder T: 'The scheduler shows the 2026-01-15 reconciliation run as completed successfully with exit status 0 at 02:14:00Z. It reports success on exit status alone and does not check whether output was produced.'

title: logs are gone
body: Responder T: 'Application logs for the reconciliation job are retained for seven days. The 2026-01-15 run is eight days ago, so there are no logs for it. Nothing was captured before they rotated.'

title: no monitoring configured
body: Responder U: 'There is no alert on this job at all, in either direction. No output-produced check, no duration check, no exit-status alert. Nobody noticed for eight days because nothing was watching.'

title: input data unavailable for replay
body: Responder U: 'The upstream extract the job reads is also on seven-day retention, so we cannot replay 2026-01-15 to see what happened. We can replay a recent date, but that tells us about today, not about then.'

title: reconciliation run for 2026-01-22
body: reconciliation job for 2026-01-22 completed at 02:31:00Z, processing 412093 rows and writing one output file. This is a different date from the failed run and is retained only because it falls inside the retention window.

title: reconciliation job release 2.1.0
body: Release 2.1.0 deployed at 17:30:00Z on 2026-01-14, roughly nine hours before the failed run. Changes: replaces the CSV writer library. The release record does not state whether the new writer signals failure by exit status.

title: no alerts fired for this job
body: A query of the alerting system for 2026-01-15 returns no alerts for the reconciliation job or its host. The query result is evidence that nothing fired, not evidence that nothing went wrong.

title: INC-1101 status
body: INC-1101 remains open. No root cause has been established. The ticket records that the 2026-01-15 output was regenerated manually from a downstream copy on 2026-01-23.
